note: Offline model catalogue. `installed` entries ship inside the binary and are verified against their sha256. `available` entries are single-file downloads with a published hash. `manual` entries are free upstream models that need a licence click-through or a format conversion, so they are listed with no url: the application installs them from a local file instead of pretending a download would work. Nothing here is fetched at runtime without the user pressing the download button on the Models screen.

models.name: Builtin ASR (Persian + English)
models.notes: Exemplar-matching acoustic model covering the phrases that ship with the application. 24-sentence test set: WER 0.34 (fa), 0.44 (en).

models.name: Builtin Translation (fa<->en)
models.notes: Bidirectional phrasebook with normalisation for Arabic/Persian character variants. Unknown words pass through unchanged.

models.name: Language pack fa<->en (everyday words)
models.notes: Extends the phrasebook with everyday vocabulary and pronunciation.

models.name: Language pack en->fa (technical terms)
models.notes: Technical and everyday terms for the English to Persian direction.

models.name: Persian punctuation and ZWNJ add-on
models.notes: Adds punctuation and half-spaces to a raw transcript.

models.name: Persian transliteration add-on (full vocalisation)
models.notes: Completes the pronunciation of rare words; the builtin transliteration stays active.

models.name: Persian speech model — large
models.notes: Wider vocabulary for continuous speech; about 1.5 GB of memory.

models.name: English speech model — base
models.notes: General English vocabulary for long recordings.

models.name: Voice activity detection add-on
models.notes: Finds sentence boundaries more accurately for long files and meetings.

models.name: Whisper Tiny (multilingual, 75 MB)
models.notes: Smallest Whisper model; fast, suited to short speech. Download URL: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-tiny.bin

models.name: Whisper Base (multilingual, 142 MB)
models.notes: Better accuracy than Tiny at a similar speed. Download URL: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-base.bin

models.name: Whisper Small (multilingual, 466 MB)
models.notes: Good accuracy for Persian; needs about 1 GB of RAM. Download URL: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-small.bin

models.name: Whisper Medium (multilingual, 1.5 GB)
models.notes: High accuracy; for a machine with enough memory. Download URL: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-medium.bin

models.name: Opus-MT fa->en (Helsinki-NLP)
models.notes: Neural translation model; installed from a local file after conversion to .osmt.

models.name: Opus-MT en->fa (Helsinki-NLP)
models.notes: Neural translation model; installed from a local file after conversion to .osmt.
